document.title: Integrated Products 2026 Australian Trials Championship, Sat 10 & Sun 11 October 2026
document.publisher: Trials Australia (posted at trials.au); www.australiantrials.com.au printed in the footer
document.software: Trialsport Scoring System - trialsport.com.au (printed, part cut off, above the Classic table on page 6)
document.notes: Seven image-only pages: six of class tables (14 classes, 91 riders) and a State Teams page. All 91 riders were read from the page images. For each rider the marks were checked against the printed lap totals, day totals, Total Score and counts of 0/1/2/3/5; all agree. Riding numbers, the course ridden each day and the day of each time penalty come from photos of the organisers' results board, not from the published sheet. The State Teams page is team scoring and is not encoded.
discrepancies: Trevor BENNETT (Classic): the published sheet has Pen. 87 and Total Score 421. The results board has time penalties of 5 (Saturday) and 87 (Sunday) and an overall total of 426.
David THOMAS (Veterans 55 Plus): the published sheet has Pen. 2 and Total Score 40. The results board shows no penalty and an overall total of 38.
Will D. (Junior): the published sheet prints DNF with all 90 sections scored. The results board shows a finished ride of 278.
Roland FERGUSON (Trial 5) and Sean AUSTIN (Trial 4): the published sheet prints DNF. The results board marks Sunday as DNS.

misfits.what: Sidecar crews are printed with one name only. The entry is a crew, but the protocol needs every person to have a role, and the sheet does not say whether the named person is the driver or the passenger; the other person is not named at all.
misfits.suggestion: Add role 'crew-member' (or 'unknown') and an entry-level crew_size or unnamed_members count so a crew with one printed name can be stated honestly.

misfits.what: Riding numbers are printed only on the State Teams page, not on the class tables. entry.number has no way to cite where in the document it came from.
misfits.suggestion: Allow a provenance note per field (x_source or a document-level 'number_source').

misfits.what: Line colour is shown only as the fill colour of each class table header (green Trial 1, red Trial 2, yellow Trial 3, blue Trial 4, white Trial 5, plus orange, magenta, lavender and light blue for other classes). It is not stated as the line ridden, so no route is encoded; class.colour holds the fill, but nothing says it is a table colour rather than a line.
misfits.suggestion: Document whether class.colour means plate, line or display colour, or split it into line_colour and display_colour.

misfits.what: A rider with a complete card (all 90 sections marked, both day totals printed) is printed DNF with no Total Score. status 'dnf' copies the printed code, but the real reason (late card, exclusion, protest) is unknown and probably not 'did not finish'.
misfits.suggestion: Add total.status_reason (free text or code) and say in the guide that status follows the printed code even when it contradicts the scores.

misfits.what: A rider scored 5 in all 90 cells and is ranked 7th. The protocol can hold the grid, but grid cells have no state, so the document cannot say whether these were ridden fives or sections not attempted and scored as fives (MoMS missing-section penalty).
misfits.suggestion: Allow an optional parallel 'states' array on a grid (ridden / missed / unknown) so missed-section fives can be told apart from ridden fives when the source says so.

misfits.what: Equal totals are separated with no printed reason; the countback can only be read off the printed mark counts. In the Junior tie the penalty is part of the tied total, and the result contradicts the final-leg rule (MoMS 15.12.1.5). row.tie_break has no flag to say the rule was inferred.

Observation totals for riders with a penalty are not printed as such: the sheet prints day totals, Pen. and Total Score. total.observation was filled with the sum of the two printed day totals, which is arithmetic rather than a printed value.
misfits.suggestion: Say in the guide whether total.observation may be derived from printed part totals, or add a 'derived' list on the total naming the fields that were calculated.

mapping.unread: All seven pages were read visually. Section marks were read from 250 to 400 dpi renders for the eight sampled riders only and each lap was checked against the printed lap total and the mark counts. Other riders were read at 100 dpi for structure, names, Pen., totals and statuses. All 91 riders' marks were later checked against the printed lap totals and mark counts; all agree.
